title_en: Wonders of Chinese Engineering (17/20): A Nuclear Power Plant on the Coast
note_en: 从而 (cóng'ér) introduces a result that follows naturally from the action before it: 再推动涡轮机转动，从而发出电力 "then spins the turbines and thereby generates electricity." It sits at the start of the second clause, much like English "thereby" or "and so," and belongs to formal, written Chinese; in conversation you would just say 所以 or nothing at all.
